Note to main agent: the problem statement's expected resale numbers (breakeven≈2,153,061, target_profit_sale_price≈4,704,081) do NOT match current calc output for the payload {P=8M, CV=12M, 5yr, loan=3.5M, rent=32k, defaults}. Current output: breakeven≈1,595,960, target≈2,101,010, xirr≈18.08%, projected_net_proceeds=7,580,000, implied_ret=16.12%. Algorithm (net(S)=0.99*S - 3.5M - tax) gives breakeven = (3.5M + net_carry)/0.99 where net_carry=-1.92M → 1.595M, matching exactly. Either spec is stale OR prior iteration had different defaults. critical_code_review_comments: Refactor extraction is clean: all 5 helper groups in server.py (register at ~L220, resale at ~L1437, portfolio at ~L434/L570, PDF at ~L1105) are pure functions with no hidden state — good. No behavior divergence observed in any endpoint tested.
_make_net_proceeds_fn closes over P/loan/broker_pct/ltcg_pct correctly; ltcg is applied only on gain = max(S-P, 0) — matches pre-refactor semantics.
_solve_sale_price_for_target uses 60-iter bisection with upper_bound = max(P*20, 1e9) — robust for wide price ranges.
_resale_xirr wraps _xirr in try/except returning 0.0 on failure — good defensive pattern.

Works correctly in UI test (modal opens, 1 lawyer card, book button shown).
AadhaarModal.jsx (NEW): Clean extraction, correct useState-driven step machine, proper regex validation on last-4 and 6-digit OTP, data-testid on all interactive elements — testable.

logger.js dev-only check `process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'` — correct; React build inlines this so production bundle has no console output (verified mentally, advisor page has no console logs during smoke test).
